newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - JUNE 3.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the June 4 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government is planning to solve the pension arrears problem at pensioners' expense, the paper says in a headline.
- Moscow's mayor is advertising his own plan for reforming the city's municipal services, different from the federal one.

- Yesterday's incident in which a Russian peacekeeper ran amok in the Georgian province Abkhazia, killing 10 of his fellows and then shooting himself, has once again emphasised problems in relations between Moscow and Tbilisi.
